column1: # wf-bench query suite (issue #440). One query per line:
# check = how Wayfinder's answer is compared with Solr's (see src/check.rs):
#   ranked  numFound equal, top results mostly overlap (scoring may differ)
#   exact   numFound equal, same ids in the same order
#   facet   numFound equal, facet field/range counts equal
#   stats   numFound equal, stats values equal
#   group   group values and per-group counts equal
#   hl      numFound equal, top ids overlap, every returned doc has a snippet
# params are written unencoded; wf-bench percent-encodes each value.
# Changing this file changes the benchmark: never edit it from the hill-climb loop.
